title: Hearty Crispy British Cheese Curds Fritters
description: A nutty, crispy British dish featuring cheese curds doubled‑fried to golden perfection, served hot and satisfying.
instructions: Set a deep pan on medium heat and pour enough vegetable oil to reach 2 inches.
In a bowl whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt and pepper until combined.
Add the beaten eggs and buttermilk to the dry mix and whisk until a smooth batter forms.
Fold in the cheese curds until evenly coated.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil and fry until the first surface is golden, about 3 minutes.
Remove fritters with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Return the fritters to the hot oil for a second fry to crisp the exterior, about 2 minutes.
Drain again, sprinkle with a pinch of salt, and serve warm.
